verdict.rationale: ADK lets you scope each agent to an explicit tool list. A built-in Tool Confirmation (human-in-the-loop) flow can guard tool execution with explicit approval and custom input. Lifecycle callbacks also offer hooks where custom permission checks could be added. However, nothing documents sandboxed execution of tools or code, and there is no declarative fine-grained permission model, so the safety half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: sandboxed code/tool execution environment, fine-grained declarative tool permission policies, independent or hands-on corroboration.
